cases.proof_skeleton: Large Z3-derived equality chain. Final chain proves x = t4, where t4 is y ◇ ((x ◇ z) ◇ (z ◇ y)), through x = t12 = t20 = t26 = t23 = t4.

route_comparison.argument_erasure_context_bridge: weak partial similarity; target requires rotation/context movement, not supported erasure
route_comparison.seed_collapse_contextual_lift: weak; no compact seed-collapse proof exists from current certificate

cases.recommendation: Leave as exact public certificate unless a much shorter local rotation/context proof skeleton is discovered.

route_comparison.argument_erasure_context_bridge: poor fit; no supported exact-context erasure edge

overall_decision.rationale: Both remaining certificates are large Z3-derived proof chains. Neither exposes a compact safe motif comparable to the generalized routes already distilled.
